description: Every sound effect of the game by a readable name; the name is the sound's id everywhere (character.json, Lua scripts, config files). Bank tones are listed in the order of the game's sound table, and an XA voice line names its row of the XA table (xa_item), so the engine knows the number the original plays by position: never reorder. Fields: slot / program / note = the entry in the game's sound table (bank slot base, weapon or ambient; program; note); volume / tone where set; banks = the bank files that hold it (the ambient bank of the maps that play it, every weapon bank for the weapon slot); files = the converted WAVs under convert/ (a replacement pack overrides them by that path); used_in = the characters and places that play it; aliases = former names that still resolve to the sound. XA voice lines (slot "xa") are streamed disc audio, not bank tones. A mod adds or rebinds names with sounds/<any>.json of the same shape. Edited by hand; the names are stable ids, never rename them (a former name goes to aliases).
